nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

beginOfferCreateTime.description: Starting value of shelf time, format `YYYY-MM-DD`

beginOrderCount.description: Starting value of number of sales

beginStartQuantity.description: Starting value of minimum purchase quantity

beginTpYear.description: Starting value of the credit pass period

buyerProtections.description: Rights protection, separate multiple choices with commas: `Free shipping for goods`, `7-day return guarantee`, `Support freight insurance`

cycle.description: Statistical period: `7` last 7 days or `30` last 30 days

endConsignPrice.description: The end value of the agency price

faceToFaceSupport.description: Farewell support, multiple selections separated by commas: `441218` Taobao, `386434` Douyin, `422914` Pinduoduo, `422978` Xiaohongshu, `386370` Kuaishou

goodsUrl.description: Product link address, choose one from `keyWord`

keyWord.description: Search keyword, must be in Chinese, maximum 50 characters

offerType.description: Product identification: `0` is not limited, `2` is new, `3` is 1688 carefully selected, `4` is cross-border, `5` supports customization, `6` is the treasure of the store

productIds.description: Product ID, multiple separated by commas, up to 20

proxyRights.description: For drop-shipping rights, multiple options must be separated by commas: `4360897`, free shipping for one piece, `449154`, purchase first, pay later

searchType.description: Search type: `1` fuzzy matching, `3` precise matching

sendTime.description: Shipping time, multiple selections separated by commas: `24`, `48`, `72`

shiLiType.description: Seller type, multiple selections separated by commas: `superFactory`, `Power`, `TrustPass`

shopService.description: Seller services, multiple selections separated by commas: `4057409` Safe Purchase, `888777` In-depth Certification Report

sortType.description: Sorting type: `desc` descending order, `asc` ascending order
